lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five vertical columns immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, followed by a staggered, more dispersed 2D distribution of larger centroids across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with primary blobs to create a grid-like pattern, most prominent in the region between the fifth gill slit and the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, dominant horizontal feature is visible running parallel to the dorsal midline, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a shadow-induced gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a slender, elongated, low-luminance biological attachment (remora) located ventrally, adjacent to the pectoral fin's leading edge.
